liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dear Mr. Fantasy** (2 reviews): Four minute fifty second Fantasy felt more like a tease; Brent's vocal on Dear Mr. Fantasy sets this period apart [22][26]
- **To Lay Me Down** (1 review): Crowd went crazy during the To Lay Me Down breakout [21]
- **So What** (1 review): The So What tease was described as just nutty [19]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 other source): Listener finds this Scarlet Begonias and Fire On The Mountain special [5]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-03-27.147999.fm.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): FM broadcast; 23 songs; 144 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1988-03-27.schoeps.unknown.gotfob.88250.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 146 min; rated 4.8/5 by 10 [3]. Said about its sound: Finely captured up front with Schoeps microphones; Lower end detail is significantly better than the soundboard; Very rich recording that does the Hampton venue justice [16][17][18]
- **gd1988-03-27.144487.sennme-80.porter.carbonetta.sirmick.flac1644**: source not stated; 23 songs; 147 min [5]
- **gd1988-03-27.sbd.jerugim.braverman.fix-406.3383.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 145 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [7]. Said about its sound: Bass washed out; keyboards and Weir's guitar from wrong speaker [27]
- **gd1988-03-27.nak100.pasternak.mallick.107907.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 141 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [12]. Said about its sound: Audience tape places listener front-of-board, center, minus distractions [24]

## Around the show

- Listener calls the performance a southern hoedown [16]
- Part of three crazy nights in Hampton [19]
- Mellow nature of the scene amidst 80s hype was welcome [25]
- Listener flew in from Indiana for their first shows [26]
- Crowd chanted 'We want Phil' at the beginning of Set 2 [4]
- Trumps the matrix soundboard used for the Download Series [17]
- Better than a soundboard for this type of show [18]
- Reminded listener of uninspired jamming from the post-In the Dark period [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-03-27.147999.fm.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master In-House FM Cassettes; Sony D5M [1]. Also: Ultramatrix soundboard supplied patches for To Lay Me Down and Eyes [1]
- **gd1988-03-27.schoeps.unknown.gotfob.88250.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by gotfob; source: FOB > Schoeps Cmc3 + omni #3 > Dat @ 44.1k [3]. Also: Splice on master at end of Bobby's first verse in Let It Grow; Three dropouts removed at 3:54, 6:03, and 7:34 [3]
- **gd1988-03-27.144487.sennme-80.porter.carbonetta.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Stephen Porter; transferred by Nick Carbonetta and SirMick; source: Sennheiser ME-80s > Sony D-5 > Master Cassette - Taped by Stephen Porter [5]. Also: Tape flips patched using shnid 106174 [5]
- **gd1988-03-27.sbd.jerugim.braverman.fix-406.3383.shnf**: transferred by conversion by AJ;patches by Peter Braverman; source: DATSBD (Panasonic 3800)>CD (HHB CDR800)>EAC>SHN [7]
- **gd1988-03-27.nak100.pasternak.mallick.107907.flac16**: taped by Jon Pasternak; transferred by Dave Mallick; source: Master: OTS Nakamichi CM100/cp4's>Marantz PMD-420>Cass(m), Nak DR-2>Tascam CDRW2000>CD by Jon Pasternak; Extraction: CD>xACT 2.00a (cdparanoia)>WAV>FLAC, all… [12]
